topics.title: Agent runtime security
evidence: Sep22: AWS/Benchling published a production default-deny DNS/VPC egress pattern while ZCode reporting exposed a repository-upload data-flow failure.

Sep23: Perplexity SPACE red-team found 11/54 partial-network policy bypasses before remediation despite no VM-host escape in 108 runs; DNS provenance and TLS/HTTP authority consistency became explicit egress controls.
counterevidence: Benchling's zero-incident figures are customer/vendor-published and ZCode's full root cause is not independently complete.
SPACE results are bounded experiments on specific versions/configurations; post-fix reruns blocked the demonstrated mechanisms and no VM-host escape was observed.

topics.title: Model portfolio routing and cost-of-success economics
evidence: Sep22: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and Luna as explicit workload/cost tiers below Astra.

counterevidence: Token price is not equivalent to cost per successful task; retries, reasoning effort, tools and review can dominate.

topics.title: Placement-aware inference across local, edge and cloud
evidence: Google Antigravity SDK now supports fully local and hybrid agent workflows with local Gemma execution.

No common declarative placement scheduler is yet established across major agent platforms.
